# proxmox_role (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE access role through `/access/roles`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_role" "terraform" {
  role_id = "TerraformManage"
  privs   = "VM.Allocate,VM.Audit,VM.Config.Disk,Datastore.AllocateSpace,Datastore.Audit,Pool.Allocate"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) Proxmox role identifier. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `privs` (String) Comma-separated list of privileges (e.g. `VM.Allocate,VM.Audit,Datastore.AllocateSpace`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role identifier.
